mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id,c.project_id,c.config_id,c.capability_version,h.name,c.status,c.content_sha256, h.revision AS configuration_revision,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id, v.entity_kind AS registered_kind,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256 FROM capability_version c JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.config_id=c.config_id AND h.project_key=c.project_key JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.version_id=c.capability_version WHERE c.kind='SCENARIO' AND c.configuration_kind='CAPABILITY' AND h.kind='CAPABILITY' AND (c.project_id IS NULL OR c.project_id=#{projectId}) ORDER BY c.capability_version LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
